name: nonexp-sudoku-pr-rust
description: Independent Rust ETH port PR verification for renamed canonical GitHub repository

steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/git
args:
expected='$COMMIT_SHA'
revision='$REVISION_ID'
[[ "$$expected" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$$ ]]
test "$$expected" = "$$revision"
test -d .git
test "$$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)" = "$$expected"
test -z "$$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"

steps.name: rust:1.99.1-bookworm
args:
rustup component add rustfmt clippy
test -f Cargo.lock
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo test --locked --offline --all-targets
cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings
